resources.string: Smart Board sends the photo straight from this device to %1$s with your own key. The key is encrypted with the Android Keystore and never leaves this device otherwise. Pick the provider in Settings → Smart Board AI.

Get the notes the best student in the room would have written: in teaching order, with ruler-straight drawings, colors that mean something and proper math, written by hand on your paper as ink you can erase.
Your photo, your key: it goes straight from this tablet to the AI provider you picked. BestNote has no servers. Nothing is kept.
No API key yet: Smart Board runs offline and writes a sample lecture so you can see how it works. Add your Gemini key to read your own boards.
